extras: Warning: This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Existing dashboard tools require users to write complex queries to generate data visualizations from frontmatter.

relations.evidence: Most dashboard tooling in Obsidian (Dataview, Dashboard Plus, …) is query-centric

summary: FieldForge is a visual property explorer that allows users to create pivot tables and charts from frontmatter fields without writing Dataview queries.
